question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Full query: Aggregate by rating category
WITH first_payment AS (
    SELECT customer_id, rental_id, payment_date
    FROM payment
    WHERE (customer_id, payment_date) IN (
        SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date)
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY customer_id
    )
),
customer_first_rental_rating AS (
    SELECT fp.customer_id, f.rating
    FROM first_payment fp
    JOIN rental r ON fp.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) AS total_rentals
    FROM payment p
    LEFT JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cfrr.rating,
    ROUND(AVG(ct.total_amount), 2) AS avg_total_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(ct.total_rentals - 1), 2) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_first_rental_rating cfrr
JOIN customer_totals ct ON cfrr.customer_id = ct.customer_id
GROUP BY cfrr.rating
ORDER BY cfrr.rating

    SELECT customer_id, rental_id, payment_date
    FROM payment
    WHERE (customer_id, payment_date) IN (
        SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date)
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY customer_id
    )
),
customer_first_rental_rating AS (
    SELECT fp.customer_id, f.rating
    FROM first_payment fp
    JOIN rental r ON fp.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) AS total_rentals
    FROM payment p
    LEFT JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cfrr.rating,
    ROUND(AVG(ct.total_amount), 2) AS avg_total_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(ct.total_rentals - 1), 2) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_first_rental_rating cfrr
JOIN customer_totals ct ON cfrr.customer_id = ct.customer_id
GROUP BY cfrr.rating
ORDER BY cfrr.rating
